# Support

## Bugs and feature requests

Open a [GitHub Issue](https://github.com/Caezarr/Vulcan/issues). Describe which agent/skill/template is affected and what you expected.

## Security vulnerabilities

Use [GitHub Security Advisories](https://github.com/Caezarr/Vulcan/security/advisories/new). See [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md).

## Scope

Vulcan is a personal agent OS toolkit. Best-effort only — no support SLA.
